paragraphs.text: Amjad is the northern part of the island of Oneah in the Domains , which also contains Shanodin , Savaea and the Red Mountains . The island lies east of Kish and northeast of Foriys , with the continent of Aerona further west.

Amjad is a swampy region of foul and blighted bogs, which around 4170 AR was ruled by the eponymous tyrant, King Amjad , whose name was revered by those who served him. After the Fall of Oneah , the cruel king was known to bring his servants into the Heart of Shanodin , to know the real nature of those whom he chose to keep at his side.
